plot_agentic_genome_outputs: plot AlphaGenome model outputs as individual panels of components with optional annotations on a matplotlib figure
create_tracks_component: create a Tracks component to visualize genomic track data as individual line plots with customizable colormaps and colors
create_contact_maps_component: create a ContactMaps component to visualize 3D genome contact maps as heatmaps using pcolormesh
create_overlaid_tracks_component: create an OverlaidTracks component to visualize overlaid track pairs such as REF and ALT tracks on the same axis
create_sashimi_component: create a Sashimi component to visualize splice junctions as a Sashimi plot with optional read count annotations
